clubSettings.title: Club Settings
clubSettings.description: Manage club information displayed in the bot

fields.addressHelper: Club address displayed in the bot
fields.phoneHelper: Club phone number displayed in the bot
fields.emailHelper: Club email address displayed in the bot
fields.additionalInfoHelper: Additional information displayed in quote format at the bottom of 'Club Info'
fields.menuPhotosHelper: Manage food and drinks menu photos displayed in the bot. Maximum 10 photos allowed.
fields.autoDeactivateEventsHelper: Automatically deactivate events and expire tickets when event end time is reached

fields.checkIntervalHelper: How often the expiration service checks for expired tickets and events (minimum 1 minute)
fields.ticketExpirationHelper: Automatically mark tickets as expired if they are not used or refunded by 12:00 PM the day after the event
fields.eventDeactivationHelper: Automatically deactivate events after they end (at 12:00 PM the day after the event)
